name: refactor_tasktracker_or404_helpers
description: Repo-scale: extract the seven duplicated lookup-or-404 blocks across three routers into shared fetch_*_or_404 helpers; broken variant drifts the 404 details
prompts: In this fastapi-tasktracker repo, the routers repeat the same lookup-or-404 block seven times: app/routers/users.py (get_user), app/routers/projects.py (get_project, list_project_tasks, project_progress), and app/routers/tasks.py (get_task, update_task, delete_task) each fetch an entity and raise HTTPException(404) when it is None. Extract that duplication: create app/routers/shared.py with fetch_user_or_404(db, user_id), fetch_project_or_404(db, project_id) and fetch_task_or_404(db, task_id) - each returns the entity or raises the 404 - and replace all seven inline blocks with calls to them. This is a pure refactor: every status code and every 404 detail string ('user not found', 'project not found', 'task not found') must remain byte-identical, and all success responses unchanged.

def test_missing_entities_keep_exact_404_contract(client):
    r = client.get("/users/12345")
    assert r.status_code == 404 and r.json()["detail"] == "user not found"

    r = client.get("/projects/12345")
    assert r.status_code == 404 and r.json()["detail"] == "project not found"

    r = client.get("/projects/12345/tasks")
    assert r.status_code == 404 and r.json()["detail"] == "project not found"

    r = client.get("/projects/12345/progress")
    assert r.status_code == 404 and r.json()["detail"] == "project not found"

    r = client.get("/tasks/12345")
    assert r.status_code == 404 and r.json()["detail"] == "task not found"

    r = client.patch("/tasks/12345", json={"title": "x"})
    assert r.status_code == 404 and r.json()["detail"] == "task not found"

    r = client.delete("/tasks/12345")
    assert r.status_code == 404 and r.json()["detail"] == "task not found"


def test_success_paths_unchanged(client):
    user = client.post("/users", json={"username": "w", "email": "w@example.com"}).json()
    project = client.post("/projects", json={"name": "W", "owner_id": user["id"]}).json()
    task = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "t", "project_id": project["id"]}).json()

    assert client.get(f"/users/{user['id']}").status_code == 200
    assert client.get(f"/projects/{project['id']}").status_code == 200
    assert client.get(f"/projects/{project['id']}/tasks").status_code == 200
    assert client.get(f"/tasks/{task['id']}").status_code == 200

    patched = client.patch(f"/tasks/{task['id']}", json={"status": "done"})
    assert patched.status_code == 200 and patched.json()["status"] == "done"
    assert client.delete(f"/tasks/{task['id']}").status_code == 204

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app import crud
from app.models.project import Project
from app.models.task import Task
from app.models.user import User


def fetch_user_or_404(db: Session, user_id: int) -> User:
    user = crud.get_user(db, user_id)
    if user is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="user not found")
    return user


def fetch_project_or_404(db: Session, project_id: int) -> Project:
    project = crud.get_project(db, project_id)
    if project is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="project not found")
    return project


def fetch_task_or_404(db: Session, task_id: int) -> Task:
    task = crud.get_task(db, task_id)
    if task is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="task not found")
    return task
